summary: Intercont (Cayman) Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing the termination of a material definitive agreement. On April 30, 2026, the company entered into a Payoff Acknowledgment and Termination Agreement with Streeterville Capital, LLC to terminate the Ordinary Share Purchase Agreement dated September 4, 2025. No deal terms or financial details were provided in the filing. This is a termination of a financing arrangement (share purchase agreement), not a merger, acquisition, or other special situation. There is no board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock mentioned. Watch for any subsequent financing or liquidity developments.
